stories.title: Brent crude futures near monthly high as Middle East tensions and Ukraine attacks tighten supply
stories.summary: Brent crude futures are trading close to the highest level recorded this month after tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and assaults on Saudi energy infrastructure raised concerns about oil export disruptions. Prices have slipped slightly in recent sessions, but analysts say the market could still break the $100 per barrel mark. Ukraine’s drone strikes on Russian refineries have added further pressure on global fuel supplies.

stories.summary: Ajay Sahai of the Federation of Indian Export Organisations said that even if a bilateral trade agreement with the United States lowers tariffs by 17 percent, Indian exporters are unlikely to gain a competitive edge. He warned that exporters could face an additional 8 percent cost if US tariffs rise to 25 percent, and noted that Southeast Asian competitors may secure more favorable terms through their own agreements.
